summary: Neo and Morpheus get into the car, where Cypher is in the driver's seat. Cypher turns to look at Neo in the rearview mirror and asks, "Well, good news or bad news?" Morpheus shuts him down: "Not now, Cypher." Cypher then "slaps the car in gear and pulls into traffic." In the moving car, Trinity turns her attention to Neo, who is "staring at the final bit of cookie." She asks, "Are you all right?" Neo puts the cookie in his mouth, chews, and replies, "... Right as rain."

what_changes.before: Curious about what the Oracle told Neo, he asks from the driver's seat, "Well, good news or bad news?"
what_changes.after: Denied the answer, he is told to drop it: "Not now, Cypher," and says nothing further.
what_changes.evidence: Well, good news or bad news? MORPHEUS Not now, Cypher.

what_changes.before: He is quiet and preoccupied, "staring at the final bit of cookie."
what_changes.after: He eats it and, when asked, claims to be fine: "... Right as rain."
what_changes.evidence: TRINITY Are you all right? NEO ... Right as rain.

event_hint.one_line: The crew drives away from the Oracle's building, with Cypher's curiosity checked and Neo putting on a brave face.

uncertain: Whether Neo's "Right as rain" is genuine reassurance or a cover for what the Oracle told him.
Whether Cypher will pursue his question about the Oracle's verdict later, since he is only told "Not now."

minds.wants: To convert Neo's private consultation into crew gossip — to get the Oracle's verdict into the open where he can weigh it.
minds.feels: Restless and entitled; he resents that a secret is being carried in his car and sees Neo's silence as a status marker he's been excluded from.
minds.shows: A gossipy, almost jovial probe from the driver's seat — "good news or bad news?" — then immediate, sullen compliance when shut down, saying nothing more.
minds.basis: He initiates the only forward question in the scene ("Well, good news or bad news?") and, when Morpheus says "Not now, Cypher," he "slaps the car in gear" and stays silent — the physical snap of the gearshift reads as displaced irritation.

believes_about.belief: That Morpheus is hoarding a verdict that concerns all of them and will keep Neo privileged with it.
believes_about.wrong_because: sc-086 shows Morpheus told Neo the secret is "for you and you alone" out of protection, not favoritism; Cypher reads a conspiracy where there is only a burden being shielded.

believes_about.belief: That Neo is sitting on something juicy and choosy about sharing it.
believes_about.wrong_because: What Neo carries (sc-085) is that he is NOT the One and that Morpheus will die for him — a crushing weight, not a prize; Cypher's assumption that it's "good or bad news" to be traded trivializes it.

minds.wants: To seal the Oracle's verdict against the crew — to stop it leaving the car, literally and figuratively.
minds.feels: Protective and already grieving-adjacent; he is holding the knowledge that he intends to trade his life for Neo's (sc-085) and will not let it become conversation.
minds.shows: A flat, minimal rebuke — "Not now, Cypher" — no justification offered, then silence.
minds.basis: In sc-086 he explicitly instructed Neo that what was said was "for you and you alone" and that he needn't tell anyone; his "Not now" here is the enforcement of that instruction the moment someone probes.

believes_about.belief: That Cypher can be contained with a single phrase and will respect the boundary.
believes_about.wrong_because: Cypher's resentment at being excluded is exactly what ev-023 turns into betrayal; Morpheus treats the shut-down as sufficient when it only stores the grievance.

minds.wants: To get through the question without exposing what he learned — to buy the crew (and Morpheus) the comfort of thinking nothing is wrong.
minds.feels: Shaken and preoccupied, carrying the double weight of "you're not the One" and "Morpheus will die to save you" (sc-085), plus a fresh instruction to keep it secret (sc-086).
minds.shows: He fixes on "the final bit of cookie," eats it, and answers Trinity's "Are you all right?" with a deflection — "... Right as rain." The pause before the line is the effort of composing the cover.
minds.basis: His silence and fixed attention on the cookie are observable; the line "Right as rain" is a false-all-clear idiom that contradicts the devastating verdict he just received, so the gap between the phrase and the known facts is the read.

believes_about.belief: That a breezy "right as rain" will satisfy her and keep Morpheus's fate off the table.
believes_about.wrong_because: Trinity's sustained look at him suggests she reads the cover even if she lets it pass; she will later be the one who learns his real stakes and stakes her own belief in him against the Oracle's verdict (ev-026).

believes_about.belief: That keeping the secret protects Morpheus.
believes_about.wrong_because: Morpheus already knows his own intended sacrifice (he sent Neo to the Oracle knowing the risk); the secrecy protects the crew's morale, not Morpheus's life — and it also isolates Neo with the choice he's been handed.

minds.wants: To check on Neo — to get a read on whether he's actually all right after being alone with the Oracle.
minds.feels: Attentive and quietly worried; she notices his preoccupation (the staring at the cookie) and presses gently rather than dropping it.
minds.shows: A soft, direct question — "Are you all right?" — and she accepts his deflection without challenging it.
minds.basis: She is the one who turns to Neo and asks after him once the car is moving; she does not pursue when he says "Right as rain," which reads as either trust or tact.

believes_about.belief: Possibly that his "Right as rain" is reassurance she can take at face value.
believes_about.wrong_because: inferred: given how intently she looks at him before asking, she may actually suspect he's covering — but she chooses not to force it, which is its own kind of reading of him.

connects_back: sc-085: the Oracle's verdict that Neo is not the One but has the gift, and that Morpheus will give his life for Neo's.
sc-086: Morpheus's instruction that the consultation was "for you and you alone" and need not be shared — the source of the crew's exclusion.
The cookie Neo carries and eats is a physical residue of the Oracle's kitchen (sc-085), anchoring his preoccupation.
sets_up: ev-023: Cypher's stored resentment at being shut out of the secret feeds his later betrayal and his demand to be cut back into the Matrix.
ev-026: Neo's privately carried verdict — that he is not the One — becomes the thing he must defy when he insists on rescuing Morpheus, and Trinity's faith counters the Oracle's words.
The sealed secret forces Neo to carry the choice between his life and Morpheus's alone, which is the pressure the coming events will test.
dramatic_function: This scene converts a private revelation into a group dynamic without releasing the secret: it shows the crew closing ranks around a truth only some of them hold, lets Cypher register his exclusion, and lets Neo practice the lie that will isolate him — the quiet car ride that stores the charges the next events will detonate.
